title: Looting at Eridu and the campaign to save it

tellings.quote: I end up finding all these photographs over the last 10 years of locals going in and just pillaging pillaging the site

plain: Eridu, an ancient city site in southern Iraq, is being stripped by looters, according to Matt LaCroix, a writer who researches ancient civilisations. LaCroix says he found many photographs, taken over the last ten years, of locals going into the site and pillaging it, and he tells it as the start of an effort to save the place before what it holds about the distant past is lost.
